blocks.en: We are now ready to define a fundamental solution.
blocks.zh: 现在已准备好定义基本解.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We call $G:[0,\infty)\to\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ a \textbf{fundamental solution} of \eqref{eq:first-order-time-evolution-fundamental-equation} if $G$ is continuously differentiable on $[0,\infty)$, and moreover, $G$ satisfies \eqref{eq:first-order-time-evolution-fundamental-equation} with the initial condition $G(\bm{x},0)=\delta(\bm{x})$.
blocks.zh: 若 $G:[0,\infty)\to\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 在 $[0,\infty)$ 上连续可微, 且 $G$ 满足 \eqref{eq:first-order-time-evolution-fundamental-equation} 及初始条件 $G(\bm{x},0)=\delta(\bm{x})$, 则称 $G$ 为 \eqref{eq:first-order-time-evolution-fundamental-equation} 的\textbf{基本解}.
blocks.label: def:evolution-fundamental-solution

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In this definition, we think of $u_t$ in \eqref{eq:first-order-time-evolution-fundamental-equation} as differentiation with respect to the parameter $t$. Nevertheless, it is easy to show that $G$ also satisfies \eqref{eq:first-order-time-evolution-fundamental-equation} in the sense of distributions on $\mathbb{R}^m\times(0,\infty)$.
blocks.zh: 在这一定义中, 将 \eqref{eq:first-order-time-evolution-fundamental-equation} 中的 $u_t$ 视为关于参数 $t$ 的微分. 尽管如此, 容易证明 $G$ 在 $\mathbb{R}^m\times(0,\infty)$ 上的分布意义下也满足 \eqref{eq:first-order-time-evolution-fundamental-equation}.
